title: eludite.file.set_encoding input
description: File > Advanced Save Options (Save With Encoding) and the status bar's encoding and line-ending items: the encoding, byte-order mark and line endings the next save writes. The document becomes dirty when they change. Without any field, reports them.

path.description: The document: an open file's absolute path, or a path relative to the workspace; the active document when omitted.

encoding.description: The encoding label: utf-8, utf-16le, utf-16be, utf-32le, utf-32be, or a code page's WHATWG label (windows-1252, shift_jis, iso-8859-2...).

bom.description: Write a byte-order mark (Unicode encodings only).

line_ending.description: crlf, lf or cr for every line break.

reopen.description: Reread the file from disk in encoding instead (Reopen With Encoding); the document must have no unsaved changes.
